items.problem: MediaElement -> MediaPlayerElement documented as a near-trivial rename, but the code-behind API surface (Source type, SetSource, playback/casting on .MediaPlayer) differs materially.
items.evidence: skill-defects.json item 1; UWP source video.SetSource(...)/video.GetAsCastingSource() (session-log 360/497/529/623/724) migrated to video.Source = MediaSource.CreateFromStream(...) (Scenario1 line 41) and video.MediaPlayer.GetAsCastingSource() (Scenario2 line 74).
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md line 615 said 'Source and transport-control properties carry over with minor renames', which is wrong for Source/SetSource and hides the .MediaPlayer indirection.
items.change: Corrected the MediaElement mapping-row note and added a focused 'MediaElement -> MediaPlayerElement code-behind (not a rename)' sub-table documenting Source via MediaSource.CreateFromUri/CreateFromStream, removal of SetSource, and Play/Pause/GetAsCastingSource on element.MediaPlayer.
items.expected_effect: Agents migrating any UWP media app emit correct MediaPlayerElement code-behind on the first pass instead of deriving it ad hoc.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of any MediaElement-based scenario, no CS1061 on SetSource/GetAsCastingSource/Play and Source is assigned a MediaSource; grep of the migrated code shows element.MediaPlayer.* for playback/casting.

items.problem: CastingDevicePicker / DevicePicker need InitializeWithWindow before .Show() on WinUI 3 desktop, but the picker section did not name them.
items.evidence: skill-coverage-gaps.json item 1; Scenario2_CastingDevicePicker.xaml.cs lines 24-26 add InitializeWithWindow.Initialize(picker, hwnd) before picker.Show(...) line 62.
items.root_cause: MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md #pickers enumerated file pickers + DataTransferManager/PrintManager but left the Show(rect)-style device/casting pickers to a vague 'other UI surfaces' catch-all.
items.change: Added CastingDevicePicker and DevicePicker (with 'before calling .Show(...)') to the explicit InitializeWithWindow surfaces sentence, and noted .Show() throws COMException at runtime with a clean build.
items.expected_effect: Agents migrating casting/device-selection UWP apps add the HWND init proactively, avoiding a runtime COMException the build cannot catch.
items.falsifiable_check: On a re-run of a casting/device-picker scenario, the migrated code calls InitializeWithWindow.Initialize on the CastingDevicePicker/DevicePicker before .Show(), and the app launches without a COMException at cast time.

deferred_to_human: unsupported-api-inventory.json could route the MediaElement 'controls' anchor to the new media-specific sub-section for a stronger inline TODO signal (Tier 1); left as-is to keep the edit minimal since the prose fix already covers it.
